name: Q-Learning
description: Synthetic experiment runner implementing Q-learning for an n-armed bandit task, simulating reinforcement learning agent behavior.

parameters.name: decision_noise
parameters.description: Softmax temperature parameter controlling decision noise (higher = more random).

parameters.name: n_actions
parameters.description: Number of available actions in the bandit task.

parameters.name: forget_rate
parameters.description: Rate at which Q-values decay toward initial values (forgetting).

parameters.name: perseverance_bias
parameters.description: Bias toward choosing the previously chosen action.

parameters.name: correlated_reward
parameters.description: Whether rewards across actions are correlated.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: DataFrame with reward sequences for each action.

outputDataType.name: observations
outputDataType.description: DataFrame with agent choice probabilities across trials.
